'''Joe Alread''' (Joseph Alread on the anagram list) was Gold 79 FL from Normal, Illinois, on the published [[Squadron Members]] roster; that fan table calls the Palejo Reshad mapping a Gold 79 intern.<ref name="sm">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas</ref><ref name="ana">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians]</ref> A fan world-finals history page places him 3rd at the 1996 Vail world finals (behind Raphael Asselin / Bjorn Sorgjerd; [[Kevin Reitzel]] 4th).<ref name="wf">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050517110350/http://trandosite.mcmail.com:80/wf00p2.htm World Championships 2000 / history of the world finals] (Wayback)</ref>

He later appears on Radio Free Decipher as a Decipher SWCCG design guest for late-era sets (Tatooine, Coruscant / Theed playtest, Reflections III / Defensive Shields) and on Decipher WARS Radio.<ref name="rfd">[https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher episode index], LOTR-TCG PC wiki</ref>

This page is a '''thin fan encyclopedia''' stub. Roles below are labeled '''only''' from RFD / WARS index descriptions &mdash; not from invented official titles.

A TheOneRing / Gaming Havens archive chat also lists Alread with [[Tom Lischke]].<ref name="haven">[http://haven.theonering.net/events/logs/decipher001.html Gaming Havens &mdash; Interview with Tom Lischke and Joe Alread], archive</ref>

Alread is '''not''' on Wikipedia's founding SWCCG designer line.<ref name="wp-swccg">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game Star Wars Customizable Card Game], Wikipedia (designer credit line)</ref> RFD 42's "Open champs" billing is '''pre-staff''' context per the research pack &mdash; do not backdate a Decipher staff title from that episode alone.
